name: Lutie
source: Although she is the next oldest after Gina, she is a reserved and quiet girl. She apparently suffers from androphobia (fear of men) and seems to have a slight lesbian streak. While she is modest, she also has a playful side, occasionally chiming in or interrupting other people's conversations out of nowhere. Due to her personality, she specializes in healing magic.
